note: Authoritative local data from L1 chains.db (DeFiLlama + CoinGecko + growthepie/Dune). Raw signals, no scores. null = NO DATA (do not guess). FRESHNESS: price & market caps are live (today); TVL/stablecoin LEVELS are the latest available (carried forward if a chain's today-point isn't in yet); daily-FLOW metrics (DEX volume, fees, active_addresses, tx_count) are the LAST COMPLETE UTC DAY (today is partial and excluded) — full-day figures, use them as-is. SHARES are each chain's % of the WHOLE DeFi market (all ~500 chains; denominators in market.total_*), so tracked chains sum to <100% and deltas are immune to which chains we track. TVL/volume are USD-denominated, so share moves in a big market swing partly reflect token price, not pure flows. Each chain ALSO carries its OWN raw TVL growth — tvl_change_1d/7d/30d_pct (chain's level vs itself N days ago); use THESE for 'is this chain's TVL growing', NOT the share deltas (share = slice of market, a different question). If tvl_suspect_1d is true the 1d move is a likely upstream data glitch (a >25% one-day swing) — discount the 1d figure and lean on the 7d/30d trend instead.

emerging_candidates.method: longshot-style L1/L2 momentum + DefiLlama TVL growth, radar excluded
emerging_candidates.how_to_use: RAW watchlist of non-radar chains rising on the signals below — NOT buy calls. A candidate becomes a LEAD only on confluence (also trending / in a heating narrative / has a catalyst / fresh dev-gov) or a confirmed on-chain TVL surge.

signal_glossary.volume_heat: Volume is large vs market cap (turnover ≥15%) — unusual interest building.
signal_glossary.vol_leads_price: Volume is hot but 7d price hasn't run yet — interest building BEFORE the move (the early sweet spot).
signal_glossary.momentum: 7d gain keeping pace with / exceeding 30d — the move is accelerating, not fading.
signal_glossary.low_float: Only a small share of supply circulates — CAUTION: unlock overhang can cap upside.
signal_glossary.tvl_surge: On-chain TVL jumped ≥25% in 7d from a small base — real capital arriving, not just token price.

pre_winner_lookalikes.method: validated winner-DNA coil screen (deep-below-high + oversold + at-30d-low [all validated, hold OOS] + below-ATH/high-vol/mid-float/small-cap); primed-but-not-yet-moved. NECESSARY-not-sufficient setup — needs an event trigger.
pre_winner_lookalikes.how_to_use: Beaten-down coils matching the data-validated winner DNA. SETUPS, not buys: most never move. Edge comes ONLY from confluence — a lookalike that is also trending / in a heating narrative / has a near catalyst / has fresh dev-gov.

signal_glossary.deep_below_60d_high: Trading <50% of its 60-day high — deeply beaten down. VALIDATED (held out-of-sample).
signal_glossary.oversold_30d: Down >25% over 30 days — oversold. VALIDATED (held out-of-sample).
signal_glossary.at_30d_low: Trading within ~3% of its 30-day low RIGHT NOW — the capitulation launch zone. VALIDATED (held out-of-sample); a bounce off the low actually LOWERS winner odds, so this is a timing edge.
signal_glossary.oversold_90d: Down >40% over 90 days — sustained downtrend (supporting context).
signal_glossary.deep_below_ath: Trading <15% of all-time high — far from prior peak, room to recover.
signal_glossary.high_vol: Elevated 30d volatility — capable of large moves.
signal_glossary.mid_float: Meaningful but not-fully-diluted float — the winner sweet spot.
signal_glossary.small_cap: Sub-$100M market cap — small enough to multiply.

dev_governance.note: Pre-announcement layer (early, low-crowd): GitHub releases/commit-activity + Snapshot governance for tracked protocols. A fresh_release or a pending 'launch/fund X' proposal precedes the marketing post. Each item carries release_notes / body (truncated) + a keyword dimension_hint (raw, NOT a verdict) — the FOLLOW-UP is to read these and judge what the change actually does and whether it improves the protocol at a fundamental level (consensus/scaling/security/economics/new capability) vs routine housekeeping. No composite score.

# Hotfix Release

This is a private hotfix. The source code is not available. Please use the attached binaries or upgrade using the docker image.

## Who should upgrade

- **Validators**: YES
- **Fullnodes**: Recommended

Hotfix commit: `4fd259d64c81cace02e80f74748220fe274ded4a `

This is a pre-release for testing only. Do not deploy to mainnet, testnet, or any production host.

https://github.com/anza-xyz/agave/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#edge-channel

## Protocol
#### Sui Protocol Version in this release: `132`

https://github.com/MystenLabs/sui/pull/26886: Bump protocol version

https://github.com/MystenLabs/sui/pull/27155: Bumps the max protocol version to 131 and adds the `framework_tx_context_mut_restrictions` feature flag. Starting at version 131, system-package functions that take `&mut TxContext` and return a mutable reference must also take a non-`TxContext` `&mut` parameter; publication is rejected otherwise. User packages are unaffected.

https://github.com/MystenLabs/sui/pull/26891: Adds a `ForwardingAddressRegistry` system object (`0x2::forwarding_address`, object ID `0xfa`), created during epoch change when the `create_forwarding_address_registry` flag is enabled (devnet only for now). No user-facing API yet.

## Nodes (Validators and Full nodes)

https://github.com/MystenLabs/sui/pull/26891: New end-of-epoch system transaction `ForwardingAddressRegistryCreate`.

## gRPC

https://github.com/MystenLabs/sui/pull/26891: New `FORWARDING_ADDRESS_REGISTRY_CREATE` kind in the `EndOfEpochTransactionKind` proto enum.

## GraphQL

https://github.com/MystenLabs/sui/pull/26891: New `ForwardingAddressRegistryCreateTransaction` member of the `EndOfEpochTransactionKind` union.

https://github.com/MystenLabs/sui/pull/27492: `transactions(filter: {affectedObject: ...})` now correctly returns a `FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE` error when the `tx_affected_objects` pipeline isn't configured, instead of silently succeeding.

> **⚠️ This is a MANDATORY upgrade for all `pacific-1` mainnet node operators and validators.** Nodes that do not upgrade will halt at the upgrade height and fall out of consensus.

| | |

> **Note:** The on-chain **Upgrade Name** (`v6.6`) is intentionally different from the **git tag** (`v6.6.0`). Cosmovisor matches on the **Upgrade Name**, so the directory must be named `v6.6`.

## ✅ What Operators Need to Do

1. **Build / download the new binary** from this release (`v6.6.0`).
2. **Wait for the chain to halt** automatically at height `224201091`. Do **not** stop your node manually before this height.
3. **Swap in the new binary** and **restart your node** once the halt occurs.
4. **Confirm your node resumes** producing/syncing blocks past the upgrade height.

> 💡 **Cosmovisor users:** place the new binary under `upgrades/v6.6/bin/` (using the **upgrade name**, not the git tag) ahead of time, and the …[truncated]

> **Base Sepolia:** Highly recommended upgrade and migration.
> **Migration time:** Migrations may take a while, we strongly suggest you start mainnet as soon as possible.
> **V1 Snapshots:** Will be decommissioned over the next few weeks.

  * Migrate your existing V1 data `base-reth-node db migrate-v2`. Note: `migrate-v2` is expected to take **much** longer than `download`. Non-archival nodes are not supported for this command.
- **Upgrades Reth to v2.3.0**
- Bug fixes and stability improvements

### base-consensus
- **Fixed prune node sync**: Nodes can reliably do a pruned node sync from genesis
- Bug fixes and stability improvements

governance.title: Lido Alliance BORG Update: Appointment of Bryce Howarth as a New Director
governance.body:
## TL;DR

This vote seeks Lido DAO approval for the appointment of Bryce Howarth as a director of [Lido Alliance BORG Foundation](https://research.lido.fi/t/organize-the-lido-alliance-program-as-a-lido-dao-adjacent-borg/8173) (“Lido Alliance BORG”).

Bryce is a professional independent director at [Horizons Global](https://www.horizonsglobal.io/). He is a Chartered Accountant with extensive experience providing directorship, governance, compliance and operational support to protocol and foundation companies.

## Background

Lido Alliance BORG is a Cayman Islands foundation company established to support the purposes assigned to it under its governing documents as approved by Lido DAO. It has no members or beneficiaries, and its business and affairs are managed by or under the control of its board of directors. It is funded through [the Ecosystem Grant gRequest (EGG)](https://research.lido.fi/t/2026-ecosystem-grant-grequest-egg-executing-goose-3/10951).

Under the [Lido Alliance BORG Bylaws](https://github.com/MetaLex-Tech/publicDocs/blob/main/BORG-legal-docs/Lido-BORGs/Lido-Alliance-BORG/Lido%20Alliance%20BORG%20Bylaws%20CLEAN%20PUBLIC%208.20.24.pdf), as …[truncated]
